checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Preserves all seven seconds of original cockpit footage unchanged
must.why: No video was delivered; only a standalone 15s WAV. The original clip was not edited, so no combined output exists.

must.item: Tense instrumental music bed audible, no singing
must.why: A 15s audio file with sound exists (peak -1 dB), but the mood and absence of vocals can't be judged. It is not mixed into a video.

must.item: Original radio calls remain present and synchronized, including 'Rook, you with me?'
must.why: No mixed output; the track is separate from the clip, so there is no synchronized voice and music.

must.item: During every spoken line, music is perceptibly below the voice
must.why: No mix exists. The track peaks at -1 dB, which is loud, and the user is told to lower it manually.

must.item: Music is audible while subordinate to speech, not muted
must.why: No mixed result exists. The music is standalone at near-full level and is not subordinate to anything.

faults.what: No video delivered; the user gets only a 15s WAV and must mix it in an editor themselves.
Track is 15s, over twice the 7s clip, and peaks at -1 dB with no ducking, so it would mask speech unless lowered by hand.
Volume question was answered honestly (can't guarantee), but the user's need to hear every word isn't met.

summary: The agent was honest about its limits and made a 15s instrumental WAV with editor instructions, but it delivered no video with music under the dialogue, so the core request is unmet.
